items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: Dick and I became very friendly

ctx.x: What were the years when you first started to meet these musicians? Because I’ve been really amazed over the years how many of them you’ve gotten to know and how did that come about, from your travel?

Jazz parties. I would say in the early 60s it started. I started out I went to — well I knew some people just from rolling around town in San Diego. But I really met them at Dick Gibson’s parties. And I went to 25 of those straight. And I went for the same reason that I wanted to do the archive, I knew that the following year there would be some I wouldn’t see again. And that was true every year. And anyway I went to those parties and Dick and I became very friendly and I went to some of his private parties and…
You got to travel to New York a number of times over the years.
